name: TA-5-width-clearance-narrow
why: 9 x 7 cells of 1 m, flat. Column 4 is excluded from the ROI except at row 3, a one-cell gap in a wall that spans the full height. A point footprint (vehicleWidth 0) passes straight along row 3 from (3,1) to (3,7) through the gap: 6 orthogonal moves, cost 6, the unique shortest route (any diagonal costs sqrt 2 for the same one column of progress).
